name: FF&S: Scenes That Didn't Happen
source:
When an author is creating a story, many times there are scenes that sound good, but don't end up making the cut.
In addition, sometimes there are scenes that could go "this way" or "that way." If "this way" is chosen, people still might be interested in seeing "that way."

This project is designed to address this.
It consists of scenes or story lines from the "Family, Friends and Strangers" world that aren't part of the FF&S story itself.
Over time, it will also allow the author to present content that fans have asked for,
but which didn't fit into the "FF&S story proper."
translation:
当作者创作一个故事时，很多时候会有一些场景听起来不错，但最终却没有成功。
此外，有时有些场景可能会“这样”或“那样”。如果选择“这样”，人们仍然可能对“那样”感兴趣。

该项目旨在解决这个问题。
它由“家人、朋友和陌生人”世界中不属于FF&S故事本身的场景或故事情节组成。
随着时间的推移，它也将允许作者呈现粉丝要求的内容，
但这并不符合“FF&S故事本身”。
